claims.text: Family hardship can outweigh standard incentives as a driver of classroom behaviour.
objections: How does this help when I come to school hungry?

claims.text: External controls can weaken internal motivation when learning becomes dependent on receiving a reward.
objections: Will this reward spoil my need to learn for myself?

claims.text: Hostile punishment can increase disruption when learners respond with anger or aggression.
objections: Does this punishment just make me angry instead of better?

claims.text: Parental care can support academic engagement when learners want to make their caregivers proud.
Visible acknowledgement can validate effort by giving learners a sense of respect at home.
